items.title: What Do People Want out of AI? New Research Finds Pastors Want a Tool; Christians Want a Friend.
items.summary: BOULDER, Colo.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Nearly half of practicing Christians (48%) say they would trust AI with their spiritual growth. New research by Barna and Gloo (Nasdaq: GLOO) asks what they want it to sound like. The research asked respondents to choose a voice, a theological perspective, and a set of qualities for AI in matters of faith. Practicing Christians are about equally likely to want AI to take on the voice of a warm, inviting pastor (26%) or an objective, unopinionated observer (25%).
